name: Misaki Kyouko
source:
She is the protagonist's aunt who is the younger sister to his mother.
Likewise, she is the aunt of Kato in which both have the same interest of collecting antique items.

Sometimes she would be snorting while sorting out the numerous antiques in the Kato family's warehouse.
She likes archeology and can even translate old manuscripts, etc.
translation:
